name: Distributor
description:
Adds the Distributor, a connected logistics building that evenly spreads incoming materials across every available output.

Features:
- Place one block or drag a line of connected Distributors.
- Materials landing on any top edge join the shared network.
- Gas can also enter from below and distribute upward; solids and liquids cannot.
- Fire is never accepted from either direction.
- Outputs rotate in deterministic round-robin order for an even split over time.
- Blocked outputs are skipped without allowing waiting material to fall through.
- Supports solids, liquids, and gases.
- Adds a dedicated Logistics research node directly after Advanced Filter.

Dev Notes:

- Feedback is 100% welcome and encouraged
